intro.en: Two friends, Fatimah and Layla, ask each other quiz questions about the Islamic world. Notice the words 'more than' and 'the most' (أَكْثَر، أَكْبَر): they follow the pattern أَفْعَل.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Fatimah aur Layla ek doosre se Islami duniya ke baare mein sawal poochti hain. Dhyan dein: أَكْثَر aur أَكْبَر jaise alfaaz 'zyada' aur 'sab se bada' ka matlab dete hain.
intro.ar: تَتَبادَلُ فاطِمَةُ وَلَيْلى أَسْئِلَةَ مُسابَقَةٍ عَنِ العالَمِ الإِسْلامِيِّ. لاحِظْ كَلِماتٍ مِثْلَ «أَكْثَر» وَ«أَكْبَر»؛ فَهِيَ عَلى وَزْنِ «أَفْعَل».

dialogue.tr: hādhihi musābaqatun ʿani l-ʿālami l-islāmiyy
dialogue.en: This is a quiz about the Islamic world.
dialogue.ur: Yeh Islami duniya ke baare mein ek musabaqa hai.

dialogue.tr: hayyā naḥulluhā maʿan
dialogue.en: Come on, let us solve it together.
dialogue.ur: Aao, isay milkar hal karein.

dialogue.tr: suʾālun laki, wa suʾālun lī
dialogue.en: A question for you, and a question for me.
dialogue.ur: Ek sawal aap ke liye, ek mere liye.

dialogue.ar: حَسَنٌ؛ السُّؤالُ الأَوَّلُ عَنْ عَدَدِ المُسْلِمينَ في العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥasan; as-suʾālu l-awwalu ʿan ʿadadi l-muslimīna fī l-ʿālam
dialogue.en: Fine; the first question is about the number of Muslims in the world.
dialogue.ur: Theek hai; pehla sawal duniya mein Musalmanon ki tadaad ke baare mein hai.

dialogue.tr: al-jawāb: aktharu min milyāri muslim
dialogue.en: The answer: more than a billion Muslims.
dialogue.ur: Jawab: ek arab se zyada Musalman.

dialogue.ar: السُّؤالُ الثّاني عَنْ عَدَدِ الدُّوَلِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: as-suʾālu th-thānī ʿan ʿadadi d-duwali l-islāmiyyah
dialogue.en: The second question is about the number of Islamic countries.
dialogue.ur: Doosra sawal Islami mulkon ki tadaad ke baare mein hai.

dialogue.ar: الجَوابُ: في العالَمِ أَرْبَعٌ وَخَمْسونَ دَوْلَةً إِسْلامِيَّةً.
dialogue.tr: al-jawāb: fī l-ʿālami arbaʿun wa khamsūna dawlatan islāmiyyah
dialogue.en: The answer: there are fifty-four Islamic countries in the world.
dialogue.ur: Jawab: duniya mein chauvan (54) Islami mulk hain.

dialogue.ar: السُّؤالُ الثّالِثُ: القارَّةُ الَّتي فيها أَكْثَرُ عَدَدٍ مِنَ المُسْلِمينَ. الجَوابُ: قارَّةُ آسيا.
dialogue.tr: as-suʾālu th-thālith: al-qārratu llatī fīhā aktharu ʿadadin mina l-muslimīn. al-jawāb: qārratu āsiyā
dialogue.en: The third question: the continent with the most Muslims. The answer: Asia.
dialogue.ur: Teesra sawal: woh barr-e-azam jis mein sab se zyada Musalman hain. Jawab: Asia.

dialogue.ar: القارَّةُ الَّتي فيها أَكْبَرُ عَدَدٍ مِنَ الدُّوَلِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ. الجَوابُ: قارَّةُ إِفْريقيا.
dialogue.tr: al-qārratu llatī fīhā akbaru ʿadadin mina d-duwali l-islāmiyyah. al-jawāb: qārratu ifrīqiyā
dialogue.en: The continent with the largest number of Islamic countries. The answer: Africa.
dialogue.ur: Woh barr-e-azam jis mein sab se zyada Islami mulk hain. Jawab: Africa.

dialogue.ar: أَكْثَرُ الدُّوَلِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ سُكّاناً. الجَوابُ: إِنْدونيسيا.
dialogue.tr: aktharu d-duwali l-islāmiyyati sukkānan. al-jawāb: indūnīsiyā
dialogue.en: The Islamic country with the most people. The answer: Indonesia.
dialogue.ur: Sab se zyada aabadi wala Islami mulk. Jawab: Indonesia.

dialogue.ar: أَكْبَرُ الدُّوَلِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ في إِفْريقيا مِساحَةً. الجَوابُ: الجَزائِر.
dialogue.tr: akbaru d-duwali l-islāmiyyati fī ifrīqiyā misāḥatan. al-jawāb: al-jazāʾir
dialogue.en: The largest Islamic country in Africa by area. The answer: Algeria.
dialogue.ur: Africa mein raqbe ke lihaaz se sab se bada Islami mulk. Jawab: Algeria.

dialogue.ar: أَقَلُّ الدُّوَلِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ سُكّاناً، وَأَصْغَرُها مِساحَةً. الجَوابُ: جُزُرُ المالْديف.
dialogue.tr: aqallu d-duwali l-islāmiyyati sukkānan, wa aṣghāruhā misāḥah. al-jawāb: juzuru l-māldīf
dialogue.en: The Islamic country with the fewest people and the smallest area. The answer: the Maldives.
dialogue.ur: Sab se kam aabadi aur sab se chhote raqbe wala Islami mulk. Jawab: Maldives.

dialogue.ar: السُّؤالُ الأَخيرُ: البَلَدُ الإِسْلامِيُّ الَّذي يَحْتَلُّهُ اليَهودُ. الجَوابُ: فِلَسْطين.
dialogue.tr: as-suʾālu l-akhīr: al-baladu l-islāmiyyu lladhī yaḥtalluhu l-yahūd. al-jawāb: filasṭīn
dialogue.en: The last question: the Islamic land the Jews occupy. The answer: Palestine.
dialogue.ur: Aakhri sawal: woh Islami mulk jis par Yahood ka qabza hai. Jawab: Filasteen.

dialogue.tr: anqadhahu llāhu minhum
dialogue.en: May Allah save it from them!
dialogue.ur: Allah ise un se bachaye!

dialogue.ar: إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ. يالَها مِنْ مُسابَقَةٍ سَهْلَةٍ!
dialogue.tr: in shāʾa llāh. yā lahā min musābaqatin sahlah
dialogue.en: If Allah wills. What an easy quiz!
dialogue.ur: In sha Allah. Kitna aasaan musabaqa hai!

q.en: According to the quiz, how many Islamic countries are there in the world?
q.ur: Quiz ke mutabiq duniya mein kitne Islami mulk hain?
q.ar: كَمْ عَدَدُ الدُّوَلِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ في العالَمِ حَسَبَ المُسابَقَةِ؟

q.en: Which continent has the most Muslims?
q.ur: Kis barr-e-azam mein sab se zyada Musalman hain?

q.en: Which continent has the largest number of Islamic countries?
q.ur: Kis barr-e-azam mein sab se zyada Islami mulk hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ قارَّةٍ فيها أَكْبَرُ عَدَدٍ مِنَ الدُّوَلِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ؟

q.en: What does أَصْغَر mean?
q.ur: أَصْغَر ka matlab kya hai?

title.ur: Mutazaad alfaaz aur do ek jaisi awazen

intro.en: Learn pairs of opposite words (أَكْبَر / أَصْغَر) and the rule of two identical letters meeting. When the first is sukoon and the second follows, they merge and are read as one letter with shaddah, like قالَتْ طائِفَةٌ read as 'qālat-tāʾifah'.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum mutazaad (ulte) alfaaz seekhenge, jaise أَكْبَر / أَصْغَر. Phir qaida: agar do ek jaise harf milen aur pehla saakin ho, to dono mil kar ek mushaddad harf ki tarah parhe jaate hain, jaise قالَتْ طائِفَةٌ.
intro.ar: تَعَلَّمْ أَزْواجاً مِنَ الكَلِماتِ المُتَضادَّةِ مِثْلَ أَكْبَر وَأَصْغَر، وَقاعِدَةَ التِقاءِ حَرْفَيْنِ مُتَماثِلَيْنِ: إِذا سَكَنَ الأَوَّلُ يُدْغَمانِ وَيُقْرَآنِ حَرْفاً واحِداً مُشَدَّداً، مِثْلَ «قالَتْ طائِفَةٌ».

q.en: What is the opposite of أَكْبَر (bigger)?
q.ur: أَكْبَر ka ulta kya hai?

q.en: What is the opposite of أَغْنَى (richer)?
q.ur: أَغْنَى ka ulta kya hai?

q.en: What is the opposite of أَقْرَب (nearer)?
q.ur: أَقْرَب ka ulta kya hai?

q.en: In قالَتْ طائِفَةٌ the letters ت and ط are read as one letter with a...
q.ur: قالَتْ طائِفَةٌ mein ت aur ط ek harf ki tarah parhe jaate hain, jis par hota hai...
q.ar: في «قالَتْ طائِفَةٌ» يُقْرَأُ حَرْفا التّاءِ وَالطّاءِ حَرْفاً واحِداً مَعَ...

intro.en: An adverb of place is a mansūb noun that tells where an action happens, for example فَوْقَ (above) and تَحْتَ (below). Example: القَلَمُ فَوْقَ الكِتابِ, 'The pen is above the book'.
intro.ur: ظَرْفُ المَكان woh ism hai jo mansoob hota hai aur batata hai ke kaam kis jagah hua, jaise فَوْقَ (upar) aur تَحْتَ (neeche). Misaal: القَلَمُ فَوْقَ الكِتابِ, yaani 'qalam kitab ke upar hai'.
intro.ar: ظَرْفُ المَكانِ اِسْمٌ مَنْصوبٌ يَدُلُّ عَلى مَكانِ حُدوثِ الفِعْلِ، مِثْلَ «فَوْقَ» وَ«تَحْتَ». مِثالٌ: القَلَمُ فَوْقَ الكِتابِ.

dialogue.tr: taqaʿu l-madīnatu shamāla makkah
dialogue.en: Madinah lies north of Makkah.
dialogue.ur: Madinah, Makkah ke shimal mein waqay hai.

dialogue.ar: يُصَلّي الإِمامُ أَمامَ المَأْمومينَ، وَهُمْ خَلْفَهُ.
dialogue.tr: yuṣallī l-imāmu amāma l-maʾmūmīn, wa hum khalfah
dialogue.en: The imam prays in front of the followers, and they are behind him.
dialogue.ur: Imam muqtadiyon ke aage namaz parhata hai aur woh us ke peeche hain.

dialogue.tr: al-faṣlu th-thānī bayna l-awwali wa th-thālith
dialogue.en: The second class is between the first and the third.
dialogue.ur: Doosra jamaat kamra pehle aur teesre ke beech mein hai.

dialogue.tr: al-qalamu fawqa l-kitāb
dialogue.en: The pen is above the book.
dialogue.ur: Qalam kitab ke upar hai.

dialogue.tr: al-kitābu taḥta l-ḥaqībah
dialogue.en: The book is under the bag.
dialogue.ur: Kitab bag ke neeche hai.

dialogue.tr: uṣallī khalfa maqāmi ibrāhīm
dialogue.en: I pray behind the Station of Ibrahim.
dialogue.ur: Main Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke peeche namaz parhta hoon.

dialogue.tr: as-sayyāratu warāʾa sh-shajarah
dialogue.en: The car is behind the tree.
dialogue.ur: Gaadi darakht ke peeche hai.

dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭabību ʿinda l-bāb
dialogue.en: The doctor is at the door.
dialogue.ur: Doctor darwaze ke paas hai.

q.en: What does فَوْقَ mean?
q.ur: فَوْقَ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word means 'between'?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz 'beech mein' ka matlab rakhta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى الوَسَطِ بَيْنَ شَيْئَيْنِ؟

q.en: Complete: الكِتابُ ___ الحَقيبَةِ (the book is under the bag).
q.ur: Mukammal karein: الكِتابُ ___ الحَقيبَةِ (kitab bag ke neeche hai).

q.en: An adverb of place is in which case?
q.ur: ظَرْفُ المَكان kis halat mein hota hai?

title.ur: Sunna aur bolna: aap ka mulk

intro.en: In this lesson you listen to a news item about a new magazine of the Muslims-Help organisation, then practise asking a classmate about your country: its name, continent, capital, people and area.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek khabar sunni hai jo Musalmanon ki madad karne wali tanzeem aur uske naye risale ke baare mein hai. Phir apne saathi se apne mulk ke baare mein sawal jawab karne hain: naam, barr-e-azam, daar-ul-hukoomat, aabadi aur raqba.
intro.ar: في هذا الدَّرْسِ تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى خَبَرٍ عَنْ مَجَلَّةٍ جَديدَةٍ لِمُنَظَّمَةِ مُسْلِمينَ هِلْب، ثُمَّ تَسْأَلُ زَميلَكَ عَنْ بَلَدِهِ: اسْمِهِ وَقارَّتِهِ وَعاصِمَتِهِ وَسُكّانِهِ وَمِساحَتِهِ.

dialogue.tr: mā ismu baladika?
dialogue.en: What is the name of your country?
dialogue.ur: Aap ke mulk ka naam kya hai?

dialogue.tr: fī ayyi qārratin baladuka?
dialogue.en: In which continent is your country?
dialogue.ur: Aap ka mulk kis barr-e-azam mein hai?

dialogue.tr: mā ʿāṣimatuh?
dialogue.en: What is its capital?
dialogue.ur: Us ka daar-ul-hukoomat kya hai?

dialogue.tr: mā ʿadadu sukkānih?
dialogue.en: What is its population?
dialogue.ur: Us ki aabadi kitni hai?

dialogue.tr: mā misāḥatuh?
dialogue.en: What is its area?
dialogue.ur: Us ka raqba kitna hai?

dialogue.tr: mā ʿadadu l-muslimīna fīh?
dialogue.en: How many Muslims are in it?
dialogue.ur: Us mein kitne Musalman hain?

q.en: How do you ask 'What is its capital?'
q.ur: 'Us ka daar-ul-hukoomat kya hai?' arabi mein kaise poochte hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ نَسْأَلُ بِهِ عَنِ العاصِمَةِ؟

q.en: What does مِساحَة mean?
q.ur: مِساحَة ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: المَقْدارُ الَّذي يَشْغَلُهُ البَلَدُ مِنَ الأَرْضِ

q.en: Which question asks about the number of people?
q.ur: Kaun sa sawal logon ki tadaad ke baare mein hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ عَدَدِ النّاسِ؟

q.en: What does مَجَلَّة mean?
q.ur: مَجَلَّة ka matlab kya hai?

title.en: Reading: Features of the Islamic world

intro.en: A reading about how Islam began in Arabia, spread quickly, united peoples of many races and languages, and gave the Islamic world an important location. Read slowly, sentence by sentence.
intro.ur: Is parhne ke hisse mein hai ke Islam ki dawat Arab se shuru hui, tezi se phaili, mukhtalif qaumon ko ek kiya aur Islami duniya ko ahem muqaam mila. Aahista aahista jumla ba jumla parhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ: بَدَأَتْ دَعْوَةُ الإِسْلامِ في الجَزيرَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ وَاِنْتَشَرَتْ بِسُرْعَةٍ، وَجَمَعَتْ شُعوباً مِنْ أَجْناسٍ وَلُغاتٍ كَثيرَةٍ، وَأَعْطَتِ العالَمَ الإِسْلامِيَّ مَوْقِعاً مُهِمّاً. اِقْرَأْ ببُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً.

dialogue.ar: بَدَأَتِ الدَّعْوَةُ الإِسْلامِيَّةُ في الجَزيرَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ، في القَرْنِ السّابِعِ المِيلادِيِّ، وَانْتَشَرَتْ سَريعاً خارِجَ الجَزيرَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: badaʾati d-daʿwatu l-islāmiyyatu fī l-jazīrati l-ʿarabiyyah, fī l-qarni s-sābiʿi l-mīlādiyy, wa-ntasharat sarīʿan khārija l-jazīrati l-ʿarabiyyah
dialogue.en: The call of Islam began in the Arabian Peninsula in the seventh century CE, and spread quickly outside it.
dialogue.ur: Islami dawat saatween sadi eesvi mein Jazeera-numa-e-Arab mein shuru hui aur Arab se bahar jald phail gayi.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ قَرْنٍ ضَمَّتْ مِساحَةً واسِعَةً مِنَ الكُرَةِ الأَرْضِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa baʿda qarnin ḍammat misāḥatan wāsiʿatan mina l-kurati l-arḍiyyah
dialogue.en: After a century it covered a wide area of the Earth.
dialogue.ur: Ek sadi ke baad is mein zameen ka bada raqba shamil ho gaya.

dialogue.ar: شَمِلَتِ المِنْطَقَةَ مِنَ الصّينِ شَرْقاً إِلى المُحيطِ الأَطْلَسِيِّ غَرْباً، وَمِنَ البَحْرِ الأَسْوَدِ وَسيبيريا شَمالاً إِلى المُحيطِ الهِنْدِيِّ جَنوباً.
dialogue.tr: shamilati l-minṭaqata mina ṣ-ṣīni sharqan ilā l-muḥīṭi l-aṭlasiyyi gharban, wa mina l-baḥri l-aswadi wa sībīriyā shamālan ilā l-muḥīṭi l-hindiyyi janūban
dialogue.en: It included the region from China in the east to the Atlantic Ocean in the west, and from the Black Sea and Siberia in the north to the Indian Ocean in the south.
dialogue.ur: Is mein China (mashriq) se Atlantic samundar (maghrib) tak aur Kala samundar aur Siberia (shimal) se Hindi samundar (junoob) tak ka ilaqa shamil tha.

dialogue.ar: دَخَلَتْ شُعوبٌ كَثيرَةٌ في الإِسْلامِ طائِعَةً؛ لِأَنَّهُ أَزالَ الظُّلْمَ عَنْها، وَحَقَّقَ لَها العَدْلَ.
dialogue.tr: dakhalat shuʿūbun kathīratun fī l-islāmi ṭāʾiʿah; li-annahu azāla ẓ-ẓulma ʿanhā, wa ḥaqqaqa lahā l-ʿadl
dialogue.en: Many peoples entered Islam willingly, because it removed injustice from them and brought them justice.
dialogue.ur: Bohat si qaumen khushi se Islam mein dakhil huin, kyunke us ne un se zulm door kiya aur unhen insaaf diya.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ جَعَلَ الإِسْلامُ مِنَ المُسْلِمينَ أُمَّةً واحِدَةً، هِيَ الأُمَّةُ الإِسْلامِيَّةُ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad jaʿala l-islāmu mina l-muslimīna ummatan wāḥidah, hiya l-ummatu l-islāmiyyah
dialogue.en: Islam made the Muslims one nation: the Islamic nation.
dialogue.ur: Islam ne Musalmanon ko ek ummat bana diya: ummat-e-Islamiyyah.

dialogue.ar: قالَ تَعالى: ﴿إِنَّ هَذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُونِ﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla taʿālā: inna hādhihī ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa ana rabbukum fa-ʿbudūn
dialogue.en: Allah the Most High said: 'Indeed this, your nation, is one nation, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.'
dialogue.ur: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: 'Beshak yeh tumhari ummat ek hi ummat hai aur main tumhara rab hoon, pas meri ibadat karo.'

dialogue.ar: وَوَحَّدَ الإِسْلامُ بَيْنَ المُسْلِمينَ، بِالرَّغْمِ مِنَ اخْتِلافِ أَعْراقِهِمْ وَأَلْوانِهِمْ وَلُغاتِهِمْ وَبيئاتِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: wa waḥḥada l-islāmu bayna l-muslimīn, bi-r-raghmi mina khtilāfi aʿrāqihim wa alwānihim wa lughātihim wa bīʾātihim
dialogue.en: Islam united the Muslims despite the differences in their races, colours, languages and environments.
dialogue.ur: Islam ne Musalmanon ko mutahid kiya, chahe un ki nasalen, rang, zabanen aur mahaul alag the.

dialogue.ar: رَبُّهُمْ واحِدٌ، وَكِتابُهُمْ واحِدٌ، وَرَسولُهُمْ واحِدٌ، وَقِبْلَتُهُمْ واحِدَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: rabbuhum wāḥid, wa kitābuhum wāḥid, wa rasūluhum wāḥid, wa qiblatuhum wāḥidah
dialogue.en: Their Lord is one, their Book is one, their Messenger is one, and their qiblah is one.
dialogue.ur: Un ka rab ek, un ki kitab ek, un ke Rasool ek aur un ka qibla ek hai.

dialogue.ar: لِلْعالَمِ الإِسْلامِيِّ مَزايا كَثيرَةٌ، جَعَلَتْهُ مِنْ أَهَمِّ المَناطِقِ في العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: lil-ʿālami l-islāmiyyi mazāyā kathīrah, jaʿalat-hu min ahammi l-manāṭiqi fī l-ʿālam
dialogue.en: The Islamic world has many advantages that make it one of the most important regions in the world.
dialogue.ur: Islami duniya ki bohat si khoobiyan hain jin ki wajah se yeh duniya ke ahem tareen ilaqon mein hai.

dialogue.ar: فَمِنْ ناحِيَةٍ، هُوَ كَالقَلْبِ لِآسِيا وَإِفْريقيا وَأُوروبّا.
dialogue.tr: fa-min nāḥiyah, huwa kal-qalbi li-āsiyā wa ifrīqiyā wa ūrūbbā
dialogue.en: For one thing, it is like the heart of Asia, Africa and Europe.
dialogue.ur: Ek taraf yeh Asia, Africa aur Europe ke liye dil ki tarah hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيُشْرِفُ عَلى كَثيرٍ مِنَ المَمَرّاتِ المائِيَّةِ: كَالبَحْرِ الأَحْمَرِ، وَالبَحْرِ الأَبْيَضِ المُتَوَسِّطِ، وَبَحْرِ العَرَبِ، وَالخَليجِ العَرَبِيِّ، وَالمُحيطِ الأَطْلَسِيِّ، وَالمُحيطِ الهِنْدِيِّ، وَالمُحيطِ الهادِئِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yushrifu ʿalā kathīrin mina l-mamarrāti l-māʾiyyah: kal-baḥri l-aḥmar, wal-baḥri l-abyaḍi l-mutawassiṭ, wa baḥri l-ʿarab, wal-khalīji l-ʿarabiyy, wal-muḥīṭi l-aṭlasiyy, wal-muḥīṭi l-hindiyy, wal-muḥīṭi l-hādiʾ
dialogue.en: It overlooks many waterways: the Red Sea, the Mediterranean, the Arabian Sea, the Arabian Gulf, and the Atlantic, Indian and Pacific Oceans.
dialogue.ur: Yeh bohat se pani ke raaston ko dekhta hai: Bahr-e-Ahmar, Bahr-e-Rome (Mediterranean), Bahr-e-Arab, Khaleej-e-Arab, aur Atlantic, Hindi aur Pacific samundar.

dialogue.ar: وَفي العالَمِ الإِسْلامِيِّ ثَرَواتٌ زِراعِيَّةٌ وَمَعْدِنِيَّةٌ وَحَيَوانِيَّةٌ عَديدَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: wa fī l-ʿālami l-islāmiyyi tharawātun zirāʿiyyatun wa maʿdiniyyatun wa ḥayawāniyyatun ʿadīdah
dialogue.en: The Islamic world also has many agricultural, mineral and animal resources.
dialogue.ur: Islami duniya mein zarai, maadni aur haiwani wasail bhi bohat hain.

q.en: Where did the call of Islam begin, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq Islami dawat kahan shuru hui?
q.ar: أَيْنَ بَدَأَتْ دَعْوَةُ الإِسْلامِ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: Why did many peoples enter Islam willingly?
q.ur: Bohat si qaumen khushi se Islam mein kyun dakhil huin?
q.ar: لِماذا دَخَلَتْ شُعوبٌ كَثيرَةٌ في الإِسْلامِ عَنْ رِضًا؟

options: It removed injustice and brought justice

q.en: Which is NOT one thing the Muslims share, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq Musalmanon mein kaun si cheez mushtarak nahin?
q.ar: أَيُّ شَيْءٍ مِمّا يَلي لَيْسَ مِمّا يَشْتَرِكُ فيهِ المُسْلِمونَ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What is the opposite of الظُّلْم (injustice)?
q.ur: الظُّلْم ka ulta kya hai?

intro.en: A verb is either sound (صَحيح: all its letters are strong, like جَلَسَ) or weak (مُعْتَل: one of its letters is a weak letter و، ا، ي). Weak verbs have four types: مِثال (weak first letter, وَجَدَ), أَجْوَف (weak middle, قالَ), ناقِص (weak last, قَضى) and لَفيف (two weak letters, وَقى).
intro.ur: Fe'l do qism ka hota hai: sahih (jis ke sab harf mazboot hon, jaise جَلَسَ) aur mu'tall (jis mein koi harf-e-illat و، ا، ي ho). Mu'tall ki chaar qismen hain: مِثال (pehla harf illat, وَجَدَ), أَجْوَف (beech wala, قالَ), ناقِص (aakhri, قَضى) aur لَفيف (do harf illat, وَقى).
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ إِمّا صَحيحٌ جَميعُ حُروفِهِ صَحيحَةٌ مِثْلَ «جَلَسَ»، وَإِمّا مُعْتَلٌّ فيهِ حَرْفُ عِلَّةٍ (و، ا، ي). وَالمُعْتَلُّ أَرْبَعَةُ أَنْواعٍ: مِثالٌ (أَوَّلُهُ حَرْفُ عِلَّةٍ: وَجَدَ)، وَأَجْوَفُ (وَسَطُهُ: قالَ)، وَناقِصٌ (آخِرُهُ: قَضى)، وَلَفيفٌ (فيهِ حَرْفا عِلَّةٍ: وَقى).

q.en: Which verb is sound (صَحيح)?
q.ur: Kaun sa fe'l sahih hai?

q.en: قالَ has a weak letter in the middle. Its type is...
q.ur: قالَ mein beech mein harf-e-illat hai. Is ki qism hai...
q.ar: في «قالَ» حَرْفُ عِلَّةٍ في الوَسَطِ. فَنَوْعُهُ...

q.en: وَجَدَ starts with a weak letter. Its type is...
q.ur: وَجَدَ harf-e-illat se shuru hota hai. Is ki qism hai...

q.en: قَضى has a weak letter at the end. Its type is...
q.ur: قَضى ke aakhir mein harf-e-illat hai. Is ki qism hai...
q.ar: «قَضى» فيهِ حَرْفُ عِلَّةٍ في الآخِرِ. فَنَوْعُهُ...

q.en: Which verb is لَفيف (two weak letters)?
q.ur: Kaun sa fe'l لَفيف hai (do harf-e-illat)?

title.en: Dialogue: Reasons for the weakness of Muslims
title.ur: Mukaalma: Musalmanon ki kamzori ki wajuhaat

intro.en: Abdussalam and Abdullah talk about why Muslims became weak and how strength can return. Notice how the dialogue names inner causes first, then outer causes, and ends with hope.
intro.ur: Abdussalam aur Abdullah baat karte hain ke Musalman kamzor kyun hue aur taqat kaise wapas aa sakti hai. Dhyan dein: pehle andaruni wajuhaat aati hain, phir bairooni, aur aakhir mein umeed.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ عَبْدُ السَّلامِ وَعَبْدُ اللهِ عَنْ أَسْبابِ ضَعْفِ المُسْلِمينَ وَكَيْفَ تَعودُ القُوَّةُ. لاحِظْ أَنَّ الحِوارَ يَذْكُرُ الأَسْبابَ الدّاخِلِيَّةَ ثُمَّ الخارِجِيَّةَ وَيَنْتَهي بِالأَمَلِ.

dialogue.tr: arāka mahmūmā. fīma tufakkir?
dialogue.en: I see you are worried. What are you thinking about?
dialogue.ur: Main aap ko pareshan dekh raha hoon. Aap kis baare mein soch rahe hain?

dialogue.ar: أُفَكِّرُ في حالِ المُسْلِمينَ هَذِهِ الأَيّامَ.
dialogue.tr: ufakkiru fī ḥāli l-muslimīna hādhihi l-ayyām
dialogue.en: I am thinking about the state of the Muslims these days.
dialogue.ur: Main in dinon Musalmanon ke haal ke baare mein soch raha hoon.

dialogue.tr: laqad aṣābahum ḍaʿfun shadīd
dialogue.en: A severe weakness has struck them.
dialogue.ur: Un par sakht kamzori aa gayi hai.

dialogue.ar: فِعْلاً، فَقَدْ كانوا أُمَّةً واحِدَةً، فَأَصْبَحوا دُوَلاً عَديدَةً.
dialogue.tr: fiʿlan, faqad kānū ummatan wāḥidah, fa-aṣbaḥū duwalan ʿadīdah
dialogue.en: True, they were one nation, and became many states.
dialogue.ur: Sach hai, woh ek ummat the, phir bohat se mulk ban gaye.

dialogue.ar: ما أَسْبابُ هَذا الضَّعْفِ في رَأْيِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: mā asbābu hādha ḍ-ḍaʿfi fī raʾyik?
dialogue.en: What are the causes of this weakness in your opinion?
dialogue.ur: Aap ki raaye mein is kamzori ki kya wajuhaat hain?

dialogue.tr: hunāka asbābun dākhiliyyah, wa ukhrā khārijiyyah
dialogue.en: There are inner causes and outer causes.
dialogue.ur: Kuch andaruni wajuhaat hain aur kuch bairooni.

dialogue.tr: li-nabdaʾ awwalan bil-asbābi d-dākhiliyyah
dialogue.en: Let us begin first with the inner causes.
dialogue.ur: Aaiye pehle andaruni wajuhaat se shuru karte hain.

dialogue.ar: أَهَمُّها ابْتِعادُ المُسْلِمينَ عَنِ الإِسْلامِ، وَكَثْرَةُ الخِلافاتِ وَالمُنازَعاتِ بَيْنَهُمْ، وَاشْتِغالُهُمْ بِما لا يُفيدُ مِنَ العِلْمِ.
dialogue.tr: ahammuhā btiʿādu l-muslimīna ʿani l-islām, wa kathratu l-khilāfāti wal-munāzaʿāti baynahum, wa shtighāluhum bimā lā yufīdu mina l-ʿilm
dialogue.en: The most important are the Muslims' distance from Islam, the many disputes and quarrels among them, and their busying themselves with knowledge that does not benefit.
dialogue.ur: Sab se ahem: Musalmanon ka Islam se door hona, un ke darmiyan bohat ikhtilafaat aur jhagde, aur aise ilm mein lag jana jo faida na de.

dialogue.tr: wa mā l-asbābu l-khārijiyyah?
dialogue.en: And what are the outer causes?
dialogue.ur: Aur bairooni wajuhaat kya hain?

dialogue.ar: أَسْبابٌ كَثيرَةٌ عَلى رَأْسِها: الاسْتِعْمارُ، وَالاسْتِشْراقُ، وَالغَزْوُ الثَّقافِيُّ.
dialogue.tr: asbābun kathīrah ʿalā raʾsihā: al-istiʿmār, wal-istishrāq, wal-ghazwu th-thaqāfiyy
dialogue.en: Many causes, foremost among them colonialism, orientalism and cultural invasion.
dialogue.ur: Bohat si wajuhaat hain, sab se pehle: isti'mar (qabza), istishraq aur saqafati yalghar.

dialogue.ar: وَما العَمَلُ؟ كَيْفَ يَرْجِعُ المُسْلِمونَ إِلى عَهْدِ القُوَّةِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa mā l-ʿamal? kayfa yarjiʿu l-muslimūna ilā ʿahdi l-quwwah?
dialogue.en: So what is to be done? How can Muslims return to the age of strength?
dialogue.ur: Phir kya karna chahiye? Musalman taqat ke daur mein kaise lautein?

dialogue.ar: إِذا رَجَعوا إِلى دينِهِمْ، وَاتَّحَدوا، وَاسْتَعانوا بِالعِلْمِ.
dialogue.tr: idhā rajaʿū ilā dīnihim, wa-ttaḥadū, wa-staʿānū bil-ʿilm
dialogue.en: If they return to their religion, unite, and seek help through knowledge.
dialogue.ur: Agar woh apne deen ki taraf lautein, mutahid hon aur ilm se madad len.

dialogue.tr: hal hādhā mumkin?
dialogue.en: Is this possible?
dialogue.ur: Kya yeh mumkin hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، مُمْكِنٌ، بِإِذْنِ اللهِ؛ فَقَدْ بَدَأَتْ عَلاماتُ ذَلِكَ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, mumkin, bi-idhni llāh; faqad badaʾat ʿalāmātu dhālik
dialogue.en: Yes, it is possible, by Allah's permission; the signs of that have already begun.
dialogue.ur: Haan, mumkin hai, Allah ke hukm se; is ki nishaniyan shuru ho chuki hain.

q.en: Which one is an inner cause of weakness mentioned in the dialogue?
q.ur: Mukaalme mein kamzori ki kaun si wajah andaruni hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سَبَبٍ داخِلِيٍّ لِلضَّعْفِ ذُكِرَ في الحِوارِ؟

q.en: Which one is an outer cause?
q.ur: Kaun si wajah bairooni hai?

q.en: How can Muslims return to the age of strength?
q.ur: Musalman taqat ke daur mein kaise lautein?
q.ar: كَيْفَ يَعودُ المُسْلِمونَ إِلى عَصْرِ القُوَّةِ؟

options: Return to their religion, unite and use knowledge
options_ar: بِالعَوْدَةِ إِلى دينِهِمْ وَالتَّوَحُّدِ وَالأَخْذِ بِالعِلْمِ

q.en: What does أَسْبابٌ داخِلِيَّةٌ mean?
q.ur: أَسْبابٌ داخِلِيَّةٌ ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: أَسْبابٌ تَأْتي مِنْ داخِلِ المُسْلِمينَ أَنْفُسِهِمْ

intro.en: An adverb of time is a mansūb noun that tells when an action happens, such as صَباحاً (in the morning), لَيْلاً (at night), قَبْلَ (before) and بَعْدَ (after). Example: ذَهَبْتُ إِلى الجامِعَةِ صَباحاً, 'I went to the university in the morning'.
intro.ur: ظَرْفُ الزَّمان woh mansoob ism hai jo batata hai ke kaam kab hua, jaise صَباحاً (subah), لَيْلاً (raat ko), قَبْلَ (pehle) aur بَعْدَ (baad). Misaal: ذَهَبْتُ إِلى الجامِعَةِ صَباحاً, yaani 'main subah university gaya'.
intro.ar: ظَرْفُ الزَّمانِ اِسْمٌ مَنْصوبٌ يَدُلُّ عَلى وَقْتِ حُدوثِ الفِعْلِ، مِثْلَ صَباحاً وَلَيْلاً وَقَبْلَ وَبَعْدَ. مِثالٌ: ذَهَبْتُ إِلى الجامِعَةِ صَباحاً.

dialogue.tr: dhahabtu ilā l-jāmiʿati ṣabāḥā
dialogue.en: I went to the university in the morning.
dialogue.ur: Main subah university gaya.

dialogue.tr: wa ʿudtu minhā masāʾā
dialogue.en: And I came back from it in the evening.
dialogue.ur: Aur main shaam ko wahan se wapas aaya.

dialogue.tr: tanāwaltu l-ghadāʾa ẓuhrā
dialogue.en: I had lunch at noon.
dialogue.ur: Main ne dopahar ko khana khaya.

dialogue.tr: sāfartu ilā makkata laylā
dialogue.en: I travelled to Makkah at night.
dialogue.ur: Main raat ko Makkah gaya.

dialogue.tr: wa rajaʿtu minhā nahārā
dialogue.en: And I returned from it by day.
dialogue.ur: Aur main din ko wahan se wapas aaya.

dialogue.tr: sa-aḥḍuru ḥīna l-ghurūb
dialogue.en: I will attend at sunset.
dialogue.ur: Main ghuroob ke waqt hazir hoon ga.

dialogue.tr: wa sa-adhhabu baʿda l-ghurūb
dialogue.en: And I will go after sunset.
dialogue.ur: Aur main ghuroob ke baad jaaoon ga.

dialogue.tr: wa arjiʿu qabla l-ʿishāʾ
dialogue.en: And I will return before the night prayer time.
dialogue.ur: Aur Isha se pehle wapas aaoon ga.

dialogue.tr: baqītu hunāka yawmā
dialogue.en: I stayed there for a day.
dialogue.ur: Main wahan ek din raha.

dialogue.tr: tastaghriqu r-riḥlatu sāʿah
dialogue.en: The trip takes an hour.
dialogue.ur: Safar mein ek ghanta lagta hai.

q.en: Which word is an adverb of time meaning 'at night'?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz 'raat ko' ke maane mein zarf-e-zaman hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ ظَرْفُ زَمانٍ يَدُلُّ عَلى وَقْتِ اللَّيْلِ؟

q.en: What does قَبْلَ mean?
q.ur: قَبْلَ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: How do you ask 'When do you go to the university?'
q.ur: 'Aap university kab jaate hain?' arabi mein kaise poochte hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ نَسْأَلُ بِهِ عَنْ وَقْتِ الذَّهابِ إِلى الجامِعَةِ؟

q.en: What does ظُهْراً mean?
q.ur: ظُهْراً ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: You listen to a report about the World Islamic Council for Da'wah and Relief, then complete sentences about its work. After that you discuss with a team the reasons for the strength of Muslims in the past and their weakness today.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Islami tanzeem 'al-Majlis al-Islami al-Alami lil-Dawah wal-Ighasa' ke baare mein khabar suni jati hai aur jumle mukammal kiye jate hain. Phir apni team ke saath bahas karni hai ke maazi mein Musalmanon ki taqat aur aaj ki kamzori ki wajuhaat kya hain.
intro.ar: تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى تَقْريرٍ عَنِ المَجْلِسِ العالَمِيِّ لِلدَّعْوَةِ وَالإِغاثَةِ، ثُمَّ تُكْمِلُ جُمَلاً عَنْ عَمَلِهِ. بَعْدَ ذلِكَ تُناقِشُ مَعَ فَريقٍ أَسْبابَ قُوَّةِ المُسْلِمينَ قَديماً وَضَعْفِهِمْ اليَوْمَ.

dialogue.ar: رَئيسُ المَجْلِسِ الإِسْلامِيِّ العالَمِيِّ لِلدَّعْوَةِ وَالإِغاثَةِ، هُوَ ...
dialogue.tr: raʾīsu l-majlisi l-islāmiyyi l-ʿālamiyyi lid-daʿwati wal-ighāthah, huwa ...
dialogue.en: The head of the World Islamic Council for Da'wah and Relief is ...
dialogue.ur: Aalmi Islami Majlis baraye Dawat o Ighasa ka sadar ... hai.

dialogue.tr: yuqaddimu l-majlisu musāʿadatahu ilā ...
dialogue.en: The council gives its help to ...
dialogue.ur: Majlis apni madad ... ko deti hai.

dialogue.tr: min ahdāfi l-munaẓẓamāti l-islāmiyyah ...
dialogue.en: Among the aims of Islamic organisations is ...
dialogue.ur: Islami tanzeemon ke maqasid mein se ... hai.

dialogue.tr: al-muslimūna juzʾun min ...
dialogue.en: Muslims are a part of ...
dialogue.ur: Musalman ... ka hissa hain.

dialogue.tr: asbābu quwwati l-muslimīna fī l-māḍī
dialogue.en: The reasons for the strength of Muslims in the past.
dialogue.ur: Maazi mein Musalmanon ki taqat ki wajuhaat.

dialogue.ar: أَسْبابُ ضَعْفِ المُسْلِمينَ في هَذا العَصْرِ.
dialogue.tr: asbābu ḍaʿfi l-muslimīna fī hādhā l-ʿaṣr
dialogue.en: The reasons for the weakness of Muslims in this age.
dialogue.ur: Is zamane mein Musalmanon ki kamzori ki wajuhaat.

q.en: What does الإِغاثَة mean?
q.ur: الإِغاثَة ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What does أَهْداف mean?
q.ur: أَهْداف ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word means 'the past'?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz 'maazi' ka matlab rakhta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى الزَّمَنِ الَّذي مَضى؟

q.en: What does فَريق mean?
q.ur: فَريق ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: A short reading about two Islamic countries: Saudi Arabia in Asia and Nigeria in Africa. You will learn their capitals, currencies and languages.
intro.ur: Do Islami mulkon ke baare mein mukhtasar tehreer: Asia mein Saudi Arabia aur Africa mein Nigeria. Un ke daar-ul-hukoomat, currency aur zabanon ke baare mein jaanenge.
intro.ar: قِراءَةٌ قَصيرَةٌ عَنْ دَوْلَتَيْنِ إِسْلامِيَّتَيْنِ: المَمْلَكَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ السُّعودِيَّةِ في آسيا وَنيجيريا في إِفْريقيا. سَتَتَعَرَّفُ إِلى عاصِمَتَيْهِما وَعُمْلَتَيْهِما وَلُغَتَيْهِما.

dialogue.ar: يَبْلُغُ عَدَدُ الدُّوَلِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ في العالَمِ أَرْبَعاً وَخَمْسينَ دَوْلَةً.
dialogue.tr: yabluġhu ʿadadu d-duwali l-islāmiyyati fī l-ʿālami arbaʿan wa khamsīna dawlah
dialogue.en: The number of Islamic countries in the world reaches fifty-four.
dialogue.ur: Duniya mein Islami mulkon ki tadaad chauvan (54) hai.

dialogue.ar: سَنُحَدِّثُكَ هُنا بِاخْتِصارٍ عَنْ دَوْلَتَيْنِ مِنْ تِلْكَ الدُّوَلِ، إِحْداهُما في قارَّةِ آسيا، وَالثّانِيَةُ في قارَّةِ إِفْريقيا.
dialogue.tr: sa-nuḥaddithuka hunā bikhtiṣār ʿan dawlatayni min tilka d-duwal, iḥdāhumā fī qārrati āsiyā, wath-thāniyatu fī qārrati ifrīqiyā
dialogue.en: Here we will tell you briefly about two of those countries, one in Asia and the other in Africa.
dialogue.ur: Yahan hum mukhtasaran un mein se do mulkon ka zikr karenge, ek Asia mein aur doosra Africa mein.

dialogue.ar: تَقَعُ المَمْلَكَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ السُّعودِيَّةُ في غَرْبِ آسيا، وَفيها بَيْتُ اللهِ الحَرامُ في مَكَّةَ المُكَرَّمَةِ، وَالمَسْجِدُ النَّبَوِيُّ في المَدينَةِ المُنَوَّرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: taqaʿu l-mamlakatu l-ʿarabiyyatu s-suʿūdiyyatu fī gharbi āsiyā, wa fīhā baytu llāhi l-ḥarāmu fī makkata l-mukarramah, wal-masjidu n-nabawiyyu fī l-madīnati l-munawwarah
dialogue.en: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia lies in western Asia. In it are the Sacred House of Allah in Makkah and the Prophet's Mosque in Madinah.
dialogue.ur: Saudi Arabia Asia ke maghrib mein waqay hai. Us mein Makkah Mukarramah mein Baitullah aur Madinah Munawwarah mein Masjid-e-Nabawi hain.

dialogue.ar: وَهُما مَكانانِ مُقَدَّسانِ يَأْتي إِلَيْهِما المُسْلِمونَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِلادِ العالَمِ؛ لِأَداءِ الحَجِّ وَالعُمْرَةِ وَالزِّيارَةِ وَالصَّلاةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa humā makānāni muqaddasāni yaʾtī ilayhimā l-muslimūna min kulli bilādi l-ʿālam; li-adāʾi l-ḥajji wal-ʿumrati waz-ziyārati waṣ-ṣalāh
dialogue.en: They are two holy places that Muslims come to from all countries of the world, to perform Hajj, Umrah, visits and prayer.
dialogue.ur: Yeh do muqaddas muqamat hain jahan duniya bhar se Musalman Hajj, Umrah, ziyarat aur namaz ke liye aate hain.

dialogue.ar: عاصِمَةُ البِلادِ الرِّياضُ، وَهِيَ مَدينَةٌ حَديثَةٌ، تَضُمُّ أَجْمَلَ المَباني.
dialogue.tr: ʿāṣimatu l-bilādi r-riyāḍ, wa hiya madīnatun ḥadīthah, taḍummu ajmala l-mabānī
dialogue.en: The capital of the country is Riyadh, a modern city containing the most beautiful buildings.
dialogue.ur: Mulk ka daar-ul-hukoomat Riyadh hai, jo ek jadeed shehar hai aur khoobsurat imaratein rakhta hai.

dialogue.ar: لُغَتُها العَرَبِيَّةُ، وَجَميعُ أَهْلِ البِلادِ مُسْلِمونَ. وَعُمْلَتُها الرِّيالُ السُّعودِيُّ. وَهِيَ غَنِيَّةٌ بِالنِّفْطِ.
dialogue.tr: lughatuhā l-ʿarabiyyah, wa jamīʿu ahli l-bilādi muslimūn. wa ʿumlatuhā r-riyālu s-suʿūdiyy. wa hiya ghaniyyatun bin-nifṭ
dialogue.en: Its language is Arabic and all the people of the country are Muslims. Its currency is the Saudi riyal. It is rich in oil.
dialogue.ur: Us ki zabaan Arabi hai aur mulk ke sab log Musalman hain. Us ki currency Saudi riyal hai aur woh tel se maalamaal hai.

dialogue.ar: تَقَعُ نَيْجيريا في غَرْبِ إِفْريقيا، وَعاصِمَتُها أَبوجا في الوَسَطِ.
dialogue.tr: taqaʿu nayjīriyā fī gharbi ifrīqiyā, wa ʿāṣimatuhā abūjā fī l-wasaṭ
dialogue.en: Nigeria lies in West Africa, and its capital is Abuja, in the middle.
dialogue.ur: Nigeria maghribi Africa mein waqay hai aur us ka daar-ul-hukoomat Abuja darmiyan mein hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَعْمَلُ مُعْظَمُ أَهْلِ البِلادِ بِالزِّراعَةِ وَالرَّعْيِ وَصَيْدِ الأَسْماكِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yaʿmalu muʿẓamu ahli l-bilādi biz-zirāʿati war-raʿyi wa ṣaydi l-asmāk
dialogue.en: Most of the people work in farming, herding and fishing.
dialogue.ur: Zyadatar log kheti, charwahi aur machhli ke shikar mein kaam karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَعُمْلَةُ البِلادِ النايرا، وَاللُّغَةُ الرَّسْمِيَّةُ لِنَيْجيريا الإِنْجليزِيَّةُ، وَيَتَحَدَّثُ أَهْلُ البِلادِ لُغاتٍ كَثيرَةً، كَالهَوسا وَاليوروبا وَالإيبو.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿumlatu l-bilādi n-nāyrā, wal-lughatu r-rasmiyyatu li-nayjīriyā l-injlīziyyah, wa yataḥaddathu ahlu l-bilādi lughātin kathīrah, kal-hawsā wal-yurūbā wal-īb
dialogue.en: The currency is the naira, and Nigeria's official language is English. The people speak many languages, such as Hausa, Yoruba and Igbo.
dialogue.ur: Mulk ki currency naira hai aur sarkari zabaan Angrezi hai. Log bohat si zabanen bolte hain, jaise Hausa, Yoruba aur Igbo.

dialogue.tr: wa yahtammu ahluhā bil-lughati l-ʿarabiyyati wa taʿallumihā
dialogue.en: Its people care about the Arabic language and learning it.
dialogue.ur: Wahan ke log Arabi zabaan aur use seekhne ka khayal rakhte hain.

intro.en: The five verbs are present-tense verbs that end with the dual alif, the plural wāw or the feminine-you yā: يَفْعَلان، تَفْعَلان، يَفْعَلون، تَفْعَلون، تَفْعَلين. They are raised by keeping the nūn (تَدْرُسانِ), and put in nasb and jazm by dropping it (لَنْ تَدْرُسا، لَمْ تَدْرُسا).
intro.ur: Af'al-e-Khamsah woh mudaare' hain jin ke aakhir mein alif-e-tasniya, waw-e-jama'at ya ya-e-mukhatabah ho: يَفْعَلان، تَفْعَلان، يَفْعَلون، تَفْعَلون، تَفْعَلين. Raf' mein noon barqarar rehta hai (تَدْرُسانِ), aur nasb aur jazm mein noon gir jata hai (لَنْ تَدْرُسا، لَمْ تَدْرُسا).
intro.ar: الأَفْعالُ الخَمْسَةُ أَفْعالٌ مُضارِعَةٌ تَنْتَهي بِأَلِفِ الاِثْنَيْنِ أَوْ واوِ الجَماعَةِ أَوْ ياءِ المُخاطَبَةِ: يَفْعَلانِ، تَفْعَلانِ، يَفْعَلونَ، تَفْعَلونَ، تَفْعَلينَ. تُرْفَعُ بِثُبوتِ النّونِ (تَدْرُسانِ)، وَتُنْصَبُ وَتُجْزَمُ بِحَذْفِها (لَنْ تَدْرُسا، لَمْ تَدْرُسا).

intro.en: Now you practise writing: a short essay on the Islamic world using the second reading, a summary of the last text, an essay on the weakness of Muslims in modern times, and an essay about your own country.
intro.ur: Ab likhne ki mashq hai: Islami duniya par mazmoon, aakhri matn ka khulasa, maujooda daur mein Musalmanon ki kamzori par mazmoon, aur apne mulk ke baare mein mazmoon.
intro.ar: الآنَ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الكِتابَةِ: مَوْضوعٌ قَصيرٌ عَنِ العالَمِ الإِسْلامِيِّ مُسْتَعيناً بِالقِراءَةِ الثّانِيَةِ، وَتَلْخيصٌ لِلنَّصِّ الأَخيرِ، وَمَوْضوعٌ عَنْ ضَعْفِ المُسْلِمينَ في العَصْرِ الحَديثِ، وَآخَرُ عَنْ بَلَدِكَ.

dialogue.ur: 'Aalam-e-Islami' ke unwan se mazmoon likhein.

dialogue.ar: اُكْتُبْ مَوْضوعاً بِعُنْوانِ: ضَعْفُ المُسْلِمينَ في العَصْرِ الحَديثِ.
dialogue.tr: uktub mawḍūʿan biʿunwān: ḍaʿfu l-muslimīna fī l-ʿaṣri l-ḥadīth

dialogue.ur: 'Jadeed daur mein Musalmanon ki kamzori' ke unwan se mazmoon likhein.

dialogue.tr: uktub mawḍūʿan ʿan baladik: ayna yaqaʿ? al-misāḥah, ʿadadu s-sukkān, al-ʿāṣimah, al-lughah, al-ʿumlah, al-iqtiṣād, at-taʿlīm
dialogue.en: Write about your country: where it lies, area, population, capital, language, currency, economy, education.
dialogue.ur: Apne mulk ke baare mein likhein: kahan waqay hai, raqba, aabadi, daar-ul-hukoomat, zabaan, currency, maeeshat, taleem.

title.en: Calligraphy and spelling: the extra alif

intro.en: First, copy a line of poetry in the Ruq'ah script. Then learn about the extra alif: it is written but not pronounced, for example after the plural wāw in a verb (اتَّفَقوا) and after a tanween-nasb noun (مُحَمَّداً).
intro.ur: Pehle Ruq'ah khat mein ek sher naqal karein. Phir ziyadat-e-alif ka qaida: yeh alif likha jata hai magar parha nahin jata, jaise fe'l mein waw-e-jama'at ke baad (اتَّفَقوا) aur tanween-e-nasb wale ism ke baad (مُحَمَّداً).
intro.ar: اِنْسَخْ أَوَّلاً بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ بِخَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ. ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمِ الأَلِفَ الزّائِدَةَ: تُكْتَبُ وَلا تُنْطَقُ، مِثْلَ الأَلِفِ بَعْدَ واوِ الجَماعَةِ في «اِتَّفَقوا» وَبَعْدَ تَنْوينِ النَّصْبِ في «مُحَمَّداً».

dialogue.ar: وَسِعْتُ كِتابَ اللهِ لَفْظاً وَغايَةً، وَما ضِقْتُ عَنْ آيٍ بِهِ وَعِظاتِ.
dialogue.tr: wasiʿtu kitāba llāhi lafẓan wa ghāyah, wa mā ḍiqtu ʿan āyin bihī wa ʿiẓāt
dialogue.en: I have encompassed the Book of Allah in wording and purpose, and I was never too narrow for its verses and admonitions.
dialogue.ur: Main ne Kitabullah ko alfaz aur maqsad dono mein samo liya, aur us ki ayaat aur nasihaton se kabhi tang nahin hua.

dialogue.ar: العُلَماءُ اتَّفَقوا وَلَمْ يَخْتَلِفوا وَلَنْ يَخْتَلِفوا في هَذِهِ المَسْأَلَةِ؛ فَاعْرِفوا لَهُمْ حَقَّهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿulamāʾu ttafaqū wa lam yakhtalifū wa lan yakhtalifū fī hādhihi l-masʾalah; faʿrifū lahum ḥaqqahum
dialogue.en: The scholars agreed, did not differ, and will not differ on this matter; so recognise their right.
dialogue.ur: Ulama is masle par mutafiq hue, un mein ikhtilaf nahin hua aur na hoga; pas un ka haq pehchano.

dialogue.tr: ashhadu anna muḥammadan rasūlu llāh
dialogue.en: I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.
dialogue.ur: Main gawahi deta hoon ke Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain.

dialogue.tr: raʾaytu fī l-ḥadīqati jamalan ḍakhmā
dialogue.en: I saw a huge camel in the garden.
dialogue.ur: Main ne baagh mein ek bada oont dekha.

dialogue.ar: وَلا خَيْرَ في حِلْمٍ إِذا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ بَوادِرُ تَحْمي صَفْوَهُ أَنْ يُكَدَّرا.
dialogue.tr: wa lā khayra fī ḥilmin idhā lam yakun lahu bawādiru taḥmī ṣafwahu an yukaddarā
dialogue.en: There is no good in forbearance that has no quick reactions to protect its purity from being clouded.
dialogue.ur: Aise hilm mein koi bhalai nahin jis ke saath woh tez rad-e-amal na ho jo us ki safai ko mailay hone se bachaye.

dialogue.ar: وَلا خَيْرَ في جَهْلٍ إِذا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ حَليمٌ إِذا ما أُوْرِدَ الأَمْرَ أَصْدَرا.
dialogue.tr: wa lā khayra fī jahlin idhā lam yakun lahu ḥalīmun idhā mā ūrida l-amra aṣdarā
dialogue.en: And there is no good in ignorance that has no forbearing person to guide the matter when it is brought to him.
dialogue.ur: Aur aise jahl mein bhi koi bhalai nahin jis ke liye koi bardbaar shakhs na ho jo muamla aane par use theek tarah nibtaye.
